page.overview:
Who is Morgan Martins?

Morgan Martins is a character from Cars 3.

Morgan Martins works for the Piston Cup 17th Rescue Race Division. He first appeared at Los Angeles 500 race at Los Angeles International Speedway and he would be seen in aftermath of McQueen's crash. Later he can be seen before the Florida 500 race when the racers get interviewed by the press at the Florida International Super Speedway.
